memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in basic ADLs, uses a walking stick for outdoor walks, manages finances.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months. Gait: slow but steady, uses cane. Timed up-and-go: 13 seconds (raised fall risk). Plan: supervised strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 0 regular. No polypharmacy.
mood: reports feeling well, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay active and continue driving short deliveries."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid: 8.2 mg/dL (ref 3.5-7.2). Serum creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, walks short distances with cane, manages household chores.
cognition: unchanged, no formal re-screen (next due April 2026).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months. Gait: steady with cane. Timed up-and-go: 12 seconds (borderline risk). Plan: continue leg exercises, check footwear.
medicines: 1 regular (allopurinol 100 mg OD). Not polypharmacy.
mood: reports occasional joint discomfort, denies low mood.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I wish to keep my driving job and avoid gout attacks."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid: 6.8 mg/dL (ref 3.5-7.2). Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, drives short routes, uses cane for longer walks.
cognition: unchanged.
falls: 1 fall in last 12 months (tripped at home, no injury). Gait: mildly unsteady. Timed up-and-go: 14 seconds (raised fall risk). Plan: physiotherapy balance training, non‑slip socks.
medicines: 1 regular (allopurinol 200 mg OD). Not polypharmacy.
mood: reports frustration after fall, denies depression.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and keep working."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid: 5.9 mg/dL (ref 3.5-7.2). Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Febuxostat 40 mg oral daily; stop allopurinol.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had a painful swelling in my big toe for two days, think it’s a gout flare. Need something for the pain.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Colchicine 0.5 mg oral twice daily for 5 days.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, drives limited routes, uses cane outdoors.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative) – annual screen completed.
falls: 0 falls in last 6 months. Gait: steady with cane. Timed up-and-go: 11 seconds (normal).
medicines: 1 regular (febuxostat 40 mg OD). Not polypharmacy.
mood: reports good spirits, denies anxiety.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to remain pain‑free and continue my work."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid: 5.2 mg/dL (ref 3.5-7.2). Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Febuxostat 40 mg oral daily; continue colchicine PRN for flares.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booking follow‑up geriatric review for 15‑Sep‑2026 at 10:00 am with Dr Kulkarni (D06).
